about: SGA 4 1/2 spot check (prepared 10 Nov 2026): six batches of five printed pages. Printed page = the Springer page number at the foot of the page (the running head at the top names the part and its own page number). Scan page index is 0-based (PDF page = index + 1). TeX spans are 1-based inclusive line ranges of the corpus file, cut at whole lines; first_prev_end: the first line starts with the last words of the previous page, through these words; last_end: the last line holds this page through these words, then the first words of the next page. The source files have CRLF line ends; the page files are written with LF, otherwise byte for byte.

edition.name: LaTeX of SGA 4 1/2 (P. Deligne, Cohomologie étale, LNM 569, 1977) typeset by Daniel Miller (src/sga4.5-note.tex; original repository https://www.github.com/dkmiller/sga4.5)
edition.copy: sga45/src: clone of https://github.com/NomiL/sga4.5 (fork of Miller's repository), branch master, commit d5266b27ed05c1486b958f43157e27cf0723639c, cloned 2026-08-06, frozen; byte-identical to the hashes in sga45/src.csv
edition.not_used: sga45/dip and sga45/corr are Codex's diplomatic and corrected French trees derived from src, repaired against the scan through physical page 70 (printed p. 65)

scan.idx_rule: idx = folio + 4 for printed pages up to 109, folio + 38 from 110 on: the Rapport (pp. 76-109) is in the scan twice (idx 80-113 and 114-147, byte-identical images); the first copy is used
